visual.general_description: Ten endoscopic frames in two rows of five, each with a printed segment label underneath.
visual.detailed_description: One page-like image with the capital letter A at the upper left and the word "Figure 1" printed at the bottom centre. Ten round endoscopic frames sit in two rows of five on a pale background, each with small partly illegible overlay text at its upper left. Row one frames, with the printed labels under them: "appendiceal orifice" (a featureless brown-pink mucosal surface), "terminal ileum" (a tubular pink-brown lumen), "ileocecal region" (a lumen with a green-yellow patch at the top), "ascending colon" (a ringed tubular lumen with dark centre) and "transverse colon" (a triangular lumen with a white mouse cursor arrow at its upper left). Row two frames: "descending colon" (a pale tan ringed lumen), "sigmoid colon" (a pale slit-like lumen), "rectum 15cm" (a pink-red mucosal surface with a dark central opening and folds), a second "rectum 15cm" (a green-tinted surface with scattered red spots and a pink irregular raised area at the lower right) and "anal margin" (a pink-red wall surrounding a large dark opening). The two frames labelled "rectum 15cm" are both labelled with that same distance.

Mucosal thickening, luminal narrowing and roughness are text claims; they are not diagnosed from the pixels.
The supplement description in the source metadata, not an article segment, names this image as endoscopic images of case 1.
